About the shop

A neighborhood barbershop in Pleasant Grove

Icyfadez Barbershop serves the Pleasant Grove area of Dallas, off Lake June Road. It's a straightforward, welcoming shop built on clean work and consistency — sharp fades, tidy beard work, and cuts for kids and adults alike.

Come in for a fresh style, a quick buzz cut, or a proper shave, and leave looking sharp. Booking is simple: call the shop or send a DM on Instagram.
